commands:
nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi
}
nft list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | grep -q '@<addr_set>[ \t]'

^(?:\[[^\]]+\])?\s*SMTP Server(?::|\s+\[[^\]]+\]) Authentication failed for user .*? \; connecting host \[?<ADDR>\]?$
^(?:\[[^\]]+\])?\s*SMTP Server(?::|\s+\[[^\]]+\]) Connection from \[?<ADDR>\]? rejected for policy reasons\.

if [ -n "" ] && ufw app info ""
then
ufw prepend reject from <ip> to any app "" comment "by Fail2Ban after <failures> attempts against domino-smtp"
else
ufw prepend reject from <ip> to any comment "by Fail2Ban after <failures> attempts against domino-smtp"
fi

if [ -n "" ] && ufw app info ""
then
ufw delete reject from <ip> to any app ""
else
ufw delete reject from <ip> to any
fi

files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
maxretry = 2
banaction_allports = nftables[type=allports]
[domino-smtp]
enabled = true
backend = polling
maxretry = 0
action = ufw
port = 0:65535
[suhosin]
enabled = true
backend = pyinotify
logpath = /dev/null
usedns = no
[apache-nohome]
enabled = true
logpath = /dev/null tail
bantime = %(findtime)s
findtime = 3600
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=rbl]

stderr: fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING Have not found any log file for 'domino-smtp' jail.
